name: synkrisis
description: Refusing scaffold for the specified comparison of validated run observations in one declared cohort.

interface.shortDescription: Refusing scaffold for the specified comparison of validated run observations in one declared cohort.
interface.longDescription: Synkrisis is the declared home for bounded comparison across validated Promise Machine run observations, but version 0.1.0 does not perform that comparison. The shipped Step 1 command declares cohort, diagnose, render and verify, then refuses each operation with stable code SK000 and writes nothing. The committed specification says that an operator will name a manifest of validated, redacted, receipt-bound observation records and a comparison policy; held steps will classify every declared run, apply a digest-bound rule catalogue, render a fixed-template report and verify the whole path. A future finding remains a bounded inferred relation with evidence, counterevidence, unknowns, the nearest claim it refuses and one suggested handoff. A person decides what happens. Synkrisis never calls a model, judges model quality, states a cause, files an issue, edits a repository or dispatches another skill.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $synkrisis to inspect the declared cross-run comparison specification and current scaffold refusals.
